|| tshad ma shes rab sgron ma zhes bya ba ||

de dag ni gzhan bsal nas nges pa'i blo gzhan sel zhes bya ba yin la | de bzhin du don gzhan bsal nas gnas pa don
gyi gzhan sel dang | gzhan bsal nas brjod pa sgra'i gzhan sel zhes bya ba yang gnas so zhes bdag gi bla ma blo gros kyi spyan dang ldan pa dag gsung ngo ||

re shig snang la ma nges pa'i mtshan nyid ni kha cig
na re snang pa'i don la nges shes 'dren mi nus pa yin no zhes zer ro rtag pa We take "rtag pa" to be an alternative way of referring to "sTag/rTag" (ID:4206) ||
yang kha cig phya rgya sgro 'dogs dang mi 'gal ba'i snang pa yin no zhes zer ba

dang po ltar na sbyor ba gsuM pa'i tshe thug par 'dod pa yin te | 'di ltar tshul gsuM chos can gtan tshigs kyi tha snyad byar rung ste tshul gsuM tshang pa'i phyir ro zhes bkod na gzhi' rtags tha dad med pa'i phyir sgra mi rtag ste sgra yin pa'i phyir zhes bkod pa lta bu'i ma grub pa yin no zhes zer ba The author of this view is identified as Phya pa (id:3831) by Glo bo mkhan chen. See Hugon (ed.) 2004: 32, n. 49. 'di ni mi 'thad de |

dang po ni kha cig na re mtshan nyid kyi mtshan nyid ni de ma yin las tha dad du 'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan nam mtshon bya rnam 'jog gi rgyu mtshan zhes bya ba yin no zhes zer ro || This view is also mentioned in Rigs gter rang 'grel (ID:5564) [CXRAK3IW] VIII 186,14 (mtshan nyid kyi mtshan nyid mtshon bya rnam 'jog gi rgyu mtshan yin na…). Rigs gter nyi ma [3C855HMK] 163,8, Rigs gter rol mtsho [32NTDJ66] Dza 70b1 (=586) and Rigs gter pham byed [7YPPPJ75] Tha 128a5 (=255) identify it as rNgog Lo tsa ba chen po (ID: 3786)'s view.

gnyis pa ni de bas na mtshan nyid kyi mtshan nyid ni chos gsuM tshang pa'am mtshon bya'i don ldog gzhi' la grub pa zhes bya ba yin te | de nyid mtshon bya mtshon pa'i rgyu mtshan yin pa'i phyir ||This definition is also cited in Rigs gter rang 'grel (ID:5564) [CXRAK3IW] VIII 186,18 chos gsum tshang ba'i mtshon bya'i don ldog gzhi la grub pa zhes gsung ngo ||. Proponents of this view are identified in Rigs gter rol mtsho [32NTDJ66] Dza 70b2 (=586) as followers of Phya pa (ID:3831). According to Rigs gter nyi ma [3C855HMK] 163,8 it is the view of Phya pa (ID:3831) and gTsang nag pa (ID:3839). See also Rigs gter pham byed [7YPPPJ75] Tha 128a6-7 (=255): de la slob dpon phywa pas | 'o na sgrub bya go byed gtan tshigs yang dag gi mtshan nyid du mtshungs so zhes skyon brjod nas | rdzas yod kyi chos gsum tshang ba de mtshan nyid kyi de yin no || zhes zer gtsang nag pa mtshon bya'i don ldog gzhi la grub pa zhes gsung ngo || For gTsang nag pa's position, see bsDus pa (ID:4549) 8a2-4: dgos pa'i mtshan nyid ngos gzung pa ni 'dir mtshan nyid ces bya ba 'ga' zhig thun mong ma yin pa'i tha snyad du mtshon pa la brjod pa na gang du mtshon bya de'i don ldog yin pa ste | tha snyad sgra blo'i zhen yul lam tha snyad du rung pa'i yul yin pa dang | gang mtshon par bya ba'i gzhi la ji ltar dgod par bya ba ltar gnas pa ste | sgrub bya go byed kyi mtshan nyid gang du bsgrub bya'i khyab bya yin pa dang gang bsgrub bya'i gzhi la grub pa'i tshul gnyis yin pa bzhin no ||

dang po ni sngon gyi bdag nyid chen po dag sgrub dang dgag pa'i mtshan nyid rim pa bzhin dgag bya rnam par bcad nas shul du chos gzhan 'phen pa dang mi 'phen pa yin te | dper na bden pas stong pa dang
bden pas stong pa'i snang pa lta bu'am bum pa stong pa dang bum pa med pa'i sa phyogs lta bu'o zhes gsung go ||

gnyis pa ni kha dog 'dzin pas reg pa la zhen pa 'dren pa tsam gyis tshad mar 'gyur na bzhin 'dzum pa 'dzin pa yang sems dga' ba la tshad mar 'gyur te de la zhen pa 'dren par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro || de la rtag na reReading rtag or stag gal te bzhin 'dzum pa 'di nyid sems dga' ba yin zhes snang yul du zhen pa 'dren pa med do zhe na | kha dog 'dzin pa yang reg pa la snang yul du zhen
pa 'dren papa{°} med pas tshad ma ma yin par 'gyur ro ||

dang po ni kha cig lo na re du bas la la rtag pa'i me dpags pas na de'i tshe me tsam la yang rjes dpag tshad ma'i cha gtan med de | rtag pa'i me la ltos nas rtags 'gal ba dang | blo log shes kho nar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro zhes zer ro ||

'dir yang tshogs pa bsgrub bya'i chos su bzung pa la ya khyal bsgrub bya'i chos su ma bzung pa 'gal lo || des na rtsang nag na re yan lag can gyi la chos can rtag pa'i me yod de | don dam pa'i du ba yod pa'i phyir dbang phyug gis byas pa'i tshang bang bzhin zhes bya ba'i sbyor ba la yang me tsam rtogs pa'i tshad ma srid pa yin no ||

gsum pa ni ¦ gangs pa na re gal te tshad ma ni ¦
yod med nges pa'i 'bras can min ||
phyir na tshad ma nyid ma yin ¦ PV I.200ab sadasanniścayaphalāneti syād vā 'pramāṇatā. Also cited in bsDus pa (ID:4549) 26b6. ma yin: PV bsDus pa (ID:4549) mi 'gyur zhes 'byung pa'i tshul gyis yod pa dang med par nges pa'i 'bras bu can yin na 'dis ni de lta
bu'i nges pa mi skyed pas tshad ma ma yin no zhe na |

yang kha cig phyaReading "phya" note entirely clear; it could also be "rgya" na re dmar 'bar ba'i rnam pa tsam la tshad mar song pa ni rang rig pa'i shugs yin te blo dmar 'bar bar 'dzin byed du grub pas yul de'i rnam pa tsam zhig mi snang pa'i sgro 'dogs chod pa yin pa'i phyir ro || des na don rig ni rnam pa tsam la tshad ma ma yin no zhes zer ro ||

dang po ni dbang po gzugs can la brten pa nyid ji ltar grub ce na | 'dir kha cig rgya grags sod na re de ni bum snang gi shes pa chos can rkyen gsuM las gzhan pa'i rkyen gzhan bzhi pa cig la ltos pa yin te rkyen gsuM tshang yang res 'ga' bar dmigs pa'i phyir ro zhes bya ba 'bras bu ldog pa'i rtags la rten pa'i rjes dpag gis sgrub po zhes zer ro ||

kha cig rtsangCf. bsDus pa (ID:4549) (ID:4550) 61b8-62a2 'di snyam du skad cig snga phyi'i rdzas de lta na yang de dag la ye shes kyis 'gro ba rtogs pa 'am sngon po nyid rtogs pa zhes bya ba yod dam myed | myed na spyi ma rtogs pa'i bye brag rtogs par 'gal la | yod na yang de nyid la ye shes phyi ma bcad pa'i shes pa ji ltar ma yin | gzhan yang rtog pa myed mod sngon ji ltar mkhyen pa'i chos rnams da ltar ma mkhyen na thams cad mkhyen par mi 'gyur la | sangs rgyas kyi chos bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba dang dran pa nyams pa mi mnga' ba zhes bya ba'i don yang ci zhig yin | des na 'jig rten mkhyen pa ni thams cad du rdzas la tshad ma nyid la ldog pa la bcad pa'i yul can nyid kho na ste |
na re rdzas la ltos nas bcad shes ma yin kyang rigs la ltos nas sngar rtogs zin la 'jug pa'i phyir bcad pa'i yul can ji ltar ma yin | gzhan yang rtog pa med mod sngon ji ltar mkhyen pa'i chos rnams da ltar ma mkhyen na thams cad mkhyen pa ma yin par 'gyur la | sangs rgyas kyi chos bsnyel pa mi mnga' ba zhes bya ba'i don yang ci zhig yin | des na thams cad mkhyen pa ni thams cad du rdzas la tshad ma dang rigs la bcad pa'i yul can yin no zhes zer ro ||

kha cig byang Tentative identification of Byang as Byang chub skyabs (ID:3864) na re rdzas la ltos nas kyang bcad pa'i yul can du 'gyur te | rdzas sngar ma rtogs pa mi srid pa'i phyir ro zhes zer ro ||

yang sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyis dus gsum ma mkhyen pa mi 'thad la | mkhyen na yang 'das ma 'ongs gnyis snang nas mkhyen nam mi snang par mkhyen | snga ma ltar mi 'thad de 'gags pa dang ma skyes pa snang par mi rung pa'i phyir ro || phyi ma ltar yang mi 'thad de sangs rgyas thams cad mngon sum spyan du mi rung pa'i phyir ro zhe na |
'di la kha cig phya 'das ma 'ongs gnyis ye shes da ltar ba la mi snang yang da ltar ba'i dngos po snang pa'i shugs la de'i rgyu' dpal dang 'bras bu ma 'ongs pa thams cad mkhyen pa yin no zhes zer ro ||

kha cig rtsangGlo bo mkhan chen also ascribes this position to "slob dpon gTsang nag pa" in Rigs gter Nyi ma 195,25: slob dpon gtsang nag pa na re | 'das ma 'ongs kyi rnam pa snang nas rtogs zhes gsung ngo ||. See Hugon (ed.) 2004: 131, n. 219 'das ma 'ongs kyi rnam pa snang pa'i stobs kyis de dag gi rang mtshan ma byung pa dang mi 'byung pa'i sgro 'dogs chod pa yin no zhes gsung mod kyi rnam pa de ci rang mtshan gyi rnam pa 'am | sgra don nam med pa'i don gsal bar snang pa yin zhes brtags na 'thad pa ma yin no || 'on kyang dus gsum mkhyen pa
lasogs pa'i ji snyed mkhyen pa'i ye shes ni gdul bya gzhan gyi blo ngor snang pa tsam du zad kyi sangs rgyas nyid kyi rgyud kyis bsdus pa yod pa ma yin pas dpyad par bya ba ma yin no ||

de la kha cig stag shes pa tsam yin pas rig pa phyi ma skyed par sgrub pa ni dgra bcom pa tha ma'i sems kyis ma nges par 'gyur bas sred pa dang bcas pa'i shes pa yin pa'i phyir ro zhes bya ba rtags khyad par can 'god par byed do || gTsang nag pa alludes to this argument in bsDus pa (ID:4549) 62b4: 'di la spyad te sred bcas ces pa'i rtags kyi khyad par smos pa'i dgos pa ci yin |

gnyis pa rtsod pa spang pa la rgol lan gnyis las |
rgol ba ni su rya A similar objection is cited in the Tshad ma rigs gter. Glo bo mkhan chen dentifies the opponent as "paṇḍita Surya thong po." See Hugon (ed.) 2004: 151, n. 269. rtsod gzhi' chos can la rjes su dpag bya'i ming gis btags nas bstan pas mi phan te | 'di ltar rjes su dpag bya'i ming de rtsod gzhi' chos can kho na la 'jug na rtags rjes su dpag bya la yod pa tshul dang po zhes brjod pas mthun pa dpe'i chos can dang mi mthun dpe'i chos can gnyis la rtags yod pa la mi go bar 'gyur ba zhig na | rjes su dpag bya ni
rtsod gzhi' dang bsgrub bya'i chos dang tshogs don gsuM ka la 'jug pas chos rjes su dpag bya la rtags yod pa dang tshogs don rjes su dpag bya la rtags yod pa yang tshul dang po yin nam snyam pa'i log rtogs skye zhing | de skyes na ma 'khrul pa'i mig gi gzung byas sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa lta bu'i rjes 'gro can la yang rtags chos rjes su dpag bya la yod pa'i tshul dang po dang rjes su 'gro ldog gnyi' ka tshang pas yang dag pa'i rtan tshigs yin nam snyam pa'i log rtogs snga ma ci lta ba bzhin du
skye bar 'gyur ro zhe na ||
'di'i lan la gzhan gyi lan dgag pa dang | rang gi lan gdab pa gnyis las

dang po ni bdag nyid chen po kha cig lo btags pas mi phan pa'i rtsod pa spang pa dang | gdags mi dgos pa'i rtsod pa spang pa dang | de'i lan mtshungs pa'i rtsod pa spang pa gsuM gyis lan 'debs par mdzad de |

dang po ni rtags rjes su dpag bya la yod pa tshul dang po zhes bya ba'i tshul dang po'i mtshan nyid ston pa'i tshig la lta ba'i dus na mthun phyogs nyid la yod ces bya ba rjes 'gro'i mtshan nyid ston pa'i zlos sgra gtan mthong pa med pas ji ltar zlos | gal te de ltar ma mthong yang 'og nas 'byung pa dang zlos so zhe na | gong du bshad pa dang 'di zlos so zhes bya ba ni rigs kyi 'og nas 'byung pa dang 'di zlos so zhes bya ba ni
rnam pa thams cad du mi 'thad pa yin no zhes rtsang nag gsung ngo ||

3 pa de'i lan mtshungs pa'i rtsod spang ni 'o na rjes su dpag bya'i ming gis btags kyang chos rjes su dpag bya dang tshogs don rjes su dpag bya la yang go dgos yod de de dag kyang rtags kyi yod gzhi' yin pa'i phyir ro zhe na | 'di la kha cig rtsang na re de dag la rtags yod kyang bsgrub pa'i ngag gis rtags kyi yod gzhir mi ston pas de dag la yod par mi go la | mthun dpe' chos can ni bsgrub pa'i ngag gis ¦ gang du ba yod pa na me yod de ¦ tshang bang bzhin zhes sam ¦ gang byas pa mi rtag ste bum pa bzhin rtags kyi yod gzhir ston pas de la
go dgos yod pa'i phyir mi mtshungs so zhes zer ro ||

kha cig khyung(khy)ung na re bsgrub bya'i chos dang tshogs don la rtags yod pa yang yod mod kyi thams cad du de dag rtags kyi yod gzhir ma nges shing mi dgos pas de dag la yod par mi go la | mthun dpe' chos can ni rnam pa thams cad du rtags kyi yod gzhir nges pas de la go dgos yod do || 'o na bsgrub bya'i chos dang tshogs don kyang rtags kyi yod gzhir nges pas de dag la yod pa la yang go dgos yod do zhe na | de dag thams cad du rtags kyi yod gzhir nges
na bsgrub chos dor bas stong nyid med dgag du bsgrub pa 'am tshul gsuM tshang pas byas pa gtan tshigs su bsgrub pa'i skabs su yang bsgrub bya'i chos dang tshogs don la gtan tshigs de dag yod par 'gyur ro || mthun dpe' yang thams cad du rtags kyi yod gzhir nges na de dag gi skabs su mthun dpe' buM med dang du ba lasogs pa la gtan tshigs de dag yod par thal lo zhe na de ni 'dod pas nyid pas mtshungs pa ma yin no zhes zer ro ||

gang dag rtsang nag rtags kyi yod gzhi' rjes su dpag bya dngos yin pa la gnod byed dang rtags las bsgrub bya dngos kyis
khyab pa la gnod byed du 'chad pa ni bshad du rung mod kyi 'di'i skabs don ma yin no ||||

dang po ni kha cig u Proponent identified with the vowel "u." Tentative identification as Ngur smrig pa (ID:4291). Compare with bsDus pa (ID:4549) 87b6-7: kha cig phyogs dang mthun pa dang mi mthun pa zhes bya ba sgra'i don nyid mtshan nyid du rtog pas bsgrub bya dang bsgrub bya'i chos kyis 'dra ba dang mi 'dra ba ste sgra'i rtag pa la ltos nas bum pa dang nam ka bzhin no zhes smra'o || mthun phyogs mi mthun phyogs kyi sgra don nyid mtshan nyid du rtogs pas phyogs dang bsgrub bya'i chos yod du mthun pa dang mi mthun pa zhes bya ba mthun phyogs dang mi mthun phyogs kyi mtshan nyid du 'dod do ||

de la mthun yul gyi phyogs ni kha cig u Vowel u. Tentative identification as Ngur smrig pa (ID:4291). Compare with bsDus pa (ID:4549) 88a5: kha cig phyogs btags pa ba rtsod gzhi dang mthun mi mthun la brjod do | na re phyogs btags pa ba rtsod gzhi' chos can yin pas phyogs btags pa ba rtsod gzhi' dang bsgrub bya'i chos yod du mthun mi mthun yin no zhes zer ro ||

'di la slob dpon dag rtsang na re rtags kyis dgag bya'i chos 'gog pa yin la 'on kyang 'gal khyab dmigs pa'i rtags kyis chos can 'gog par mi 'gyur te chos can ni stong nyid la ltos pa'i med dgag gi tha snyad yin la dgag bya'i chos med dgag gi tha snyad la ltos pa'i med dgag gi tha snyad yin pas de dag ltos pas ldog pa tha dad pa'i phyir ro zhes gsung ngo ||

re zhig phyogs snga ma dgod pa ni blo gros chen po dag phya A parallel presentation of this position is found, but in a shorter version, in gTsang nag pa (ID:3839)'s bsDus pa (ID:4549) 92b8-93b3; gTsang nag pa does not identify its author, but says only "slob dpon dag". 'di skad du 'chad de | rtags chos can gyi phyogs cig la ma grub pa phyogs chos kyi skyon ma yin pa dang | rtags kyi phyogs cig chos can la ma grub pa mi srid pa dang | de gnyis mi mtshungs pa'o ||

de dgag pa la yang rtsang pasCompare this passage with bsDus pa (ID:4549) 93b3-94b4. bsDus pa (ID:4549)'s formulation of the arguments is different, but the position seem to coincide with the one presented in sGron ma. gsuM ste | rtags chos can gyi phyogs cig la ma grub pa phyogs chos kyi skyon yin pa dang | rtags kyi phyogs cig ma grub pa srid pa dang | de gnyis mtshungs
pa'o ||

che ba'i che ba dag rtags kyi tha snyad gnas pa'i rten du mtshan nyid tshul gsuM blos nges par byas pa mi dgos ste | rnam gcod med pa dang | don gyi chos su mi 'thad pa dang | ha cang thal ba'i phyir ro ||

yang blo gros rnam par dkar ba dag na re rtags kyi mtshan nyid du tshul gsuM blos nges par byas pa zhig dgos pa yin te | nges rung la ni bsgrub bya'i mtshan nyid dang mtshungs pa dang | tshul gsuM dngos po la ma grub pa dang ma mtshungs pa dang | ha cang thal ba'i skyon gsum yod pa'i phyir ro ||

dang po ni phyogs chos grub cing rtsang chos dang chos can tshogs pa'i spyi las ldog pa grub pa ste ma grub pa dang ma nges pa dang yang dag gi rtags rnams bcad pa'i phyir ro zhes gsungs mod kyi de ltar na sgrub chos dor bas stong nyid med dgag du sgrub pa lasogs pa'i yang dag 'ga' zhig la khyab ches so snyam mo || 'o na gang yin na ¦ phyogs chos grub cing chos dang chos can tshogs pa'i spyi phyin ci log du byed ces gsungo ||

de la 'brel pa spyi'i
mtshan nyid ni kha cigkhyung na re chos gang zhig chos gzhan la rag las zhes zer te ¦ rang gi lugs ni‹kha cig na re chos gang zhig chos gzhan la rag las zhes zer te ¦ rang gi lugs ni› chos gang zhig chos gzhan mi 'dor ba'o ||

des na kha cig ma yin dgag gi 'brel pa chos gzhan mi 'dod pa zhes zer ba niThe view corresponds to that of Phya pa (ID:3831) in Mun sel (ID:4502) 81b6: chos 'ga' zhig gis ma yin dgag gi chos gzhan dbye' ba med pas mi 'dor ba zhes bya ba bdag 1 pa'i mtshan nyid yod pas mi rigs te |
med dgag gi 'brel pa la ma khyab pa'i phyir ro ||

dang po kha cig rngog na re rgyu 'bras nges par byed pa'i tshad ma ni thams cad du ma dmigs pa dang dmigs pa'i mngon suM lnga kho nas yin te | 'di ltar dang
po rgyu 'bras gnyis ka ma dmigs pa dang | de nas rgyu dmigs pa dang | de nas 'bras bu dmigs pa dang | de nas rgyu log pas rgyu ma dmigs pa dang | de nas 'bras bu log pas 'bras bu ma dmigs pa'i mngon sum mo zhes zer ro || This view is already mentioned in bsDus pa (ID:4549) 142a8-142b1 (kha cig gzhung las gsungs pa'i mi dmigs pa dang dmyigs pa'i mngon sum lngas de'i mtshan nyid rjes 'gro dang ldog pa nges pa yin no zhes zer ro ||). It is also the view supported in rNam bshad 333,3-4 (mngon sum dang myi dmyigs pa rnam pa lngas rgyu 'bras kyi mtshan nyid nges pas de kho na tshad ma yin no ||). de ni mi 'thad de | khyung gnas skabs kyi rjes su 'gro ldog mthong pa'i tshad ma lngas nges pa yin nam 'on te rang bzhin gyi rjes su 'gro ldog mthong pa'i tshad ma lngas nges pa yin | dang po ltar na rnga'i sgra dang nyi ma'i 'od zer yang rgyu
'bras su thal te gnas skabs kyi rjes su 'gro ldog lan brgyar mthong pa'i phyir ro || gnyis pa ltar na tshad ma lnga yis ci zhig bya ste rang bzhin gyi rjes su 'gro ldog mthong pa'i tshad ma gsuM gyis rjes 'gro dngos su nges pas ldog pa shugs la 'phen pa'i phyir ro ||

gsuM pa ni rtag pa 'gyur med du grub pas mi rtag pa khegs pa de ltar na sgra lasogs pa cung zad 'gyur bar grub pa rnaMs la rtag pa nyid mngon sum gyis khegs par thal ba dang |
byas{°}byas pa dang yod pa yang rtag pa la mngon suM gyis khegs par thal te | rgyu rkyen las sngar med gsar du byas pas 'gyur ba yin pa'i phyir ro zhe na | sgra lasogs pa 'gyur bar grub pas 'jig pa ye med kyi rtag pa yin pa khegs par thal ba ni 'dod la | 'on kyang skad cig mar mi 'grub ste rang bzhin rtag par dogs pa'i phyir ro || byas pa yang rtag pa la rtsang mi khegs te byas pa nyid kyi tshe 'gyur bar grub kyang thog mar byas nas mi 'gyur bar
dogs pa'i phyir ro || yod pa tsam ldog ni 'gyur bas khyad par du ma byas pas rtag pa la yang khegs par mi 'gyur ro ||

yang na de dag kyang bya ba rdzogs pa'i skad cig gsuM
las ldog pa yin no zhes gsung ngo{°}ngo ||Cf. the position criticized in Rigs gter rang 'grel (ID:5564) [CXRAK3IW] VII 171,18-22: la la bya rdzogs skad cig gsum || 'ga' zhig yul ring 'grogs zhes zer || kha cig spang bya dang gnyen po gnyis bya ba rdzogs pa'i skad cig gsum la ldog pa dang | kha cig da lta nas rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi bar du bskal pa dpag med du gnod bya gnod byed 'grog so zhes zer ba. The authors are identified in Rigs gter nyi ma [3C855HMK] 155,15 as "slob dpon bZad pa" and "slob dpon Cha pa" (i.e. Phya pa) etc. (slob dpo bzad pa dang | slob dpon cha pa la sogs pa 'ga' zhig | spang bya dang gnyen po gnyis da lta nas rdo rjes lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyi bar du bsal pa dpag tu med par gnod bya dang gnod byed du 'grogs so zhes zer ba dang | la la dag bya rdzogs kyi skad cig ma gsum la spang bya ldog go zhes zer ba).

dang po ni sngon gyi blo grosgros{°} chen po dag thal ba'i chos gsuM dang bzlog pa'i chos gsuM thams cad du gnad cig par 'chad de | 'di ltar thal ba'i gtan tshigs khas blangs dang bzlog pa'i bsgrub bya shes 'dod gnyis tshang pa dang ma tshang pa dang tshang par gnad gcig ste | pha rol po la la me med par khas len na gnyi' ka tshang la | mi len na gnyis ka ma tshang pa'i phyir ro ||
